task.title: Issues source repository (project repo) in keryx issues list
task.description: Plan slice 2. Add "repository" to the accepted list sources: in src/integrations/issues-board.ts ListIssueRequest.source accepts "repository" and lists REST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues (state, direction, sort=updated, per_page 40, since, labels; pull requests excluded) for the GitHub repository of the project; resolve owner/repo from the command cwd the way the PR board (keryx review board) resolves its default repository (find that resolver under src/review or src/integrations with keryx ctx rg; reuse it, do not invent a new git-remote parser). The cursor scope must include the repo so a cursor cannot be replayed for another repo. Keep IssueScope in issues-contract.ts unchanged for the user scopes; add a separate exported type for the list source (e.g. IssueListSource = IssueScope | "repository") so Desktop can use it. src/commands/issues.ts passes cwd as needed. A project without a GitHub remote gives a clear configuration: error. Tests in src/integrations/issues-board.test.ts (repository listing, PR exclusion, pagination cursor scoped to repo, missing remote error).
